title: Assigned to me shows the same matching work orders in every display
custom_preconds:
Dev-layer test — be-functional. Existing coverage: ViewWorkOrderBoardTest.php:215 (List vs board parity); merged into E2E C96911

Preconditions

  • Needs: 1 user · 1 browser · about 15 minutes.
  • Sign in as an Admin (on a QA branch: the Admin quick-login button on the sign-in page; you appear as "Admin ShopView"). Desktop browser window at least 1024 px wide; narrower windows show only the List.
  • Work in one location throughout, shown next to the bell in the top bar (e.g. "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919"); to change it click your initials (top right) > Change Location. Create everything in that location.
  • Customer "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Assigned To Me" (this case only) with four Approved work orders: two led by you, one led by another technician, one with no lead. Only your two have you as Service Advisor.
  • Names and numbers are examples, except names the expected results quote, which must be used exactly.

Setup

  1. Make yourself a lead technician: Settings > Staff > your own row's edit icon > Active, Time Clock on, this location in Location > Save.
  2. Technicians: your initials (top right) > Settings > Staff. A person counts as a technician only if Active, Time Clock on, Role not Office User or Time Clock User, and this location in Location. To add one: New Staff Member > First Name, Last Name, Email, Role "Technician", one Department (required), Location = this location, Time Clock on > Save & Close. You need: one other technician, [Tech-A] (the expected results call it "Ralph Edwards").
  3. Customer: Customers > New Customer > Name "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Assigned To Me" > Save. On its Contacts tab > New Contact > First and Last Name > Save. On its Assets tab > New Asset > pick the contact, Year, Make (required), Model, Unit "TRK-118" > Save.
  4. Work orders for "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Assigned To Me": Work Orders > Create Work Order > pick the Customer and its Asset > Save (if a credit-limit Confirmation appears, click Create). In the New Line form that opens, type in "What Are You Doing?" and pick a ready-made line (e.g. "Replace - Brake pot"), turn Line Approved on > Save & Close: the status reads Approved. Write down the work order number (top left). Then pick the lead in Lead Technician on the card at the left of the work order page; it saves at once.
    • [WO-1] ("S1-702" in the expected results): lead = you.
    • [WO-2] ("S1-644"): lead = you.
    • [WO-3] ("S1-691"): lead = [Tech-A].
    • [WO-4] ("S1-352"): no lead.
  5. Whoever creates a work order becomes its Service Advisor, and Assigned to me also shows those. So on [WO-3] and [WO-4], in the card at the left, set Service Advisor to someone other than you (e.g. [Tech-A]).
  6. Check: Work Orders > All tab > Search "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Assigned To Me" shows [WO-1] and [WO-2] (lead: you), [WO-3] (lead [Tech-A]) and [WO-4] (no lead). If your name is missing from the Lead Technician list, redo the first setup step. Clear the search.
custom_steps:
1. Open Work Orders.
  2. Click the All tab on the left of the toolbar.
  3. In List, click Search and type ZZAUTOTEST F1 Assigned To Me.
  4. In List, turn on Assigned to me.
  5. Write down every work order shown (with this setup: [WO-1] and [WO-2], 2 rows).
  6. In the display switcher at the right of the toolbar, click Tech View (tooltip "Tech View").
  7. Write down every work order shown and the groups they are in.
  8. In the display switcher at the right of the toolbar, click Board View (tooltip "Board View").
  9. Write down every card shown and the columns they are in.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Tech View and Board View show exactly the work orders List shows with Assigned to me on (example: S1-702 and S1-644, 2 in each display) and no others.
  • S1-691 (Ralph Edwards) and S1-352 (no lead) do not appear in any display.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043; story SV-10044 (Story 1, Switch between display options); PRD Confluence 845185030, edited 7 Oct 2026 (status line "PRD v33"), S1-R13, read 8 Oct 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S1-R13: “With Assigned to me enabled, show only the work orders that match the existing Assigned to me rules, in every display option.”
